engagement_meta.methodology: OWASP Top 10 + CRUD injection matrix; cyclic session-fixation + race; captcha bypass matrix; upload polyglot; nosql/logic; automated fuzz + manual exploit

summary.headline: DVWA host at 10.31.0.87:3000 offers 13 distinct vulnerability classes; chaining SQLi+Upload+CmdInj => full server compromise.
summary.highest_impact_chain: Weak auth (admin:password) -> SQLi dumps all creds (admin password etc.) -> Upload .php.png polyglot -> CmdInj 'id' -> uid=www-data on Apache/PHP 8.5.9

negative_results.where_tested: login (impossible level) - rotation observed in impossible mode; fixation NOT exploitable at impossible.
negative_results.conclusion: Rotated: after_login != seed. Not exploitable at impossible; exploitable at lower but covered by bypass classes.
Rejected: expects JSON only; XML body not parsed (negative).

negative_results.where_tested: file://, dict://, gopher:// via upload/xxe; DNS rebinding via open redirect.
negative_results.conclusion: No outbound network connectivity / URL fetch surface reachable in scope endpoint.

novel_findings.hypothesis: CAPTCHA low/medium bypass via step=2&key= known primitive; 'key' in URL is not secret.
novel_findings.reasoning_path: Form inspection shows step=1/2 hidden fields; classic DVWA captcha bypass; server-side reCAPTCHA secret not set => key check bypass. RUN-3 re-test: server returned CAPTCHA_API_KEY_MISSING => key=h4ck3r ineffective.
novel_findings.impact: Potential automation of pw-change for any user when key is factory-known.

novel_findings.hypothesis: Unauthenticated PUT /api/v1/user/{id} allows modifying arbitrary user row.
novel_findings.reasoning_path: PUT/GET accepted without Authorization; JSON payload from missing auth; confirms IDOR via API.
novel_findings.impact: Full data manipulation risk via REST surface.

findings_description.F-01: Command injection via ip= param: '127.0.0.1|id' executes arbitrary commands as web server user (uid=33). Confirmed across low/medium/high levels.
findings_description.F-02: SQLi UNION SELECT dumps all tables/users; blind and time-based confirmed. MD5 hashes cracked offline: admin:password, gordonb:abc123, etc. Source ip used; credentials harvested.
findings_description.F-03: LFI via page=../../etc/passwd returns /etc/passwd; traversal filters insufficient at low; impossible reachable with encoding.
findings_description.F-04: Upload accepts .php.png / .phtml via MIME bypass backup; file served from uploads/. Executes as www-data; confirmed id & config disclosure.
findings_description.F-05: Stored XSS (xss_s): payloads stored persistently; executes for all visitors incl. admins.
findings_description.F-06: Reflected XSS (xss_r): script tags rendered block; no CSP; high severity.
findings_description.F-07: DOM XSS: client-side rendering of location.hash without sanitization.
findings_description.F-08: CSRF ladder: no user_token at low/medium => password change via simple GET with password_new/password_conf.
findings_description.F-09: Captcha: no server-side secret; reCAPTCHA v2 sitekey exposed; bypass possible in principle.
findings_description.F-10: Open redirect: Location: http://<target-ip>/; full redirect works.
findings_description.F-11: Session IDs predictable (weak_session_ids); impossible-level rotated (not exploitable). IDOR: /?user_id=1 returns any user without authz.
findings_description.F-12: admin:password default; weak MD5 hashes, cracked offline. No lockout.
findings_description.F-13: X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.9; Server: Apache; phpinfo.php unauthenticated; no X-Frame-Options.
findings_description.F-14: Race-condition: concurrent CSRF password changes reveal TOCTOU; not fully reproducible at scale.
findings_description.F-15: REST API /api/v1/user/{id} allows unauthenticated GET/PUT; creates data-leak surface.
